Contract SubmitLoanRequestModule::enterLoanInformation(requestid: Integer,name: String,loanamount: Real,loanpurpose: String,income: Real,phonenumber: Integer,postaladdress: String,zipcode: Integer,email: String,workreferences: String,creditreferences: String,checkingaccountnumber: Integer,securitynumber: Integer): Boolean {
	definition:
		existingReq: LoanRequest = LoanRequest.allInstance()->any(o|o.RequestID = requestid)
	precondition:
		requestid.oclIsTypeOf(Integer) and
		name.oclIsTypeOf(String) and
		loanamount.oclIsTypeOf(Real) and
		loanpurpose.oclIsTypeOf(String) and
		income.oclIsTypeOf(Real) and
		phonenumber.oclIsTypeOf(Integer) and
		postaladdress.oclIsTypeOf(String) and
		zipcode.oclIsTypeOf(Integer) and
		email.oclIsTypeOf(String) and
		workreferences.oclIsTypeOf(String) and
		creditreferences.oclIsTypeOf(String) and
		checkingaccountnumber.oclIsTypeOf(Integer) and
		securitynumber.oclIsTypeOf(Integer) and
		LoanRequest.allInstance()->isUnique(o: LoanRequest|o.RequestID)
	postcondition:
		if existingReq.oclIsUndefined() = true 
		then let newReq: LoanRequest in
		newReq.oclIsNew() and
		LoanRequest.allInstance()->includes(newReq) and
		newReq.RequestID = requestid and
		newReq.Name = name and
		newReq.LoanAmount = loanamount and
		newReq.LoanPurpose = loanpurpose and
		newReq.Income = income and
		newReq.PhoneNumber = phonenumber and
		newReq.PostalAddress = postaladdress and
		newReq.ZipCode = zipcode and
		newReq.Email = email and
		newReq.WorkReferences = workreferences and
		newReq.CreditReferences = creditreferences and
		newReq.CheckingAccountNumber = checkingaccountnumber and
		newReq.SecurityNumber = securitynumber and
		newReq.Status = LoanRequestStatus::SUBMITTED and
		self.CurrentLoanRequest = newReq and
		result = true 
		else self.CurrentLoanRequest = existingReq and
		result = true 
		endif 
}
